_comment: Tripwires, not targets. A pin that trips one of these has observed a ports
commit that does not match what upstream actually published, or a ports
overlay change landed without a pin refresh. Either way a human should look
before the build spends hours acting on it.
Reviewed 2026-11-18 against verified signed catalogues and observed ports:
The Expat security overlay adds 125 amd64 / 101 arm64 reverse dependents
to the delta. Keep this closure; do not substitute stock binaries for it.
Allow modest headroom for this reviewed security rebuild while retaining
the existing drift ceilings and all overlay, ABI and checksum checks.
